text:
Nadia (PM): Quick huddle: we need a launch-gating matrix for private deploys that captures upgrade guarantees, egress/IP preservation, and install presets. Low-noise doc we can hand to sales.
Ravi (Eng): Agree. Propose three simple tiers: Community (self-serve), Managed (field-assisted), Enterprise (contracted guarantees).
Tomas (Infra): Technical caveats: Enterprise guarantees (pinned versions, preserved egress) have storage and KV-cache migration costs. Call them out in the matrix.
Jordan (Sales): Sales want one-sentence lines we can paste into quotes. e.g., 'Preserved egress IP: best-effort (Community) | reserved with signup (Managed) | contractually reserved (Enterprise)'.
Priya (Legal): Also need a short clause about "blackout requests": default is advisory; only enforceable for Enterprise and when documented in the SOW.
Nadia (PM): Good. How do we price blackout windows? Monthly slot vs per-event?
Jordan (Sales): Customers prefer a monthly reserved slot for predictable coverage. Charge a recurring fee + a per-event premium if they request additional per-event holds.
Ravi (Eng): Implementational note: monthly slots are easy to block, per-event requires on-call labor and rollback risk. We should tie per-event pricing to a runbook cost multiplier.
Tomas (Infra): Add an ops impact field: e.g., 'on-call hours', 'rollback RTO delta', and 'storage delta'. Make those numbers visible in the matrix.
Priya (Legal): For contracts, short phrasing suggestion: 'Customer blackout windows are binding only for Enterprise tier when enumerated in the SOW. Other tiers receive best-effort accommodation.'
Nadia (PM): Let's include an "install preset" section with concrete examples so field engineers can recommend configs quickly.
Ravi (Eng): Draft presets below (for docs):
```yaml
preset: community
telemetry: true
upgrade_policy: automated_rolling
egress_ip_preservation: best_effort
blackout_guarantee: none
```
```yaml
preset: managed
telemetry: opt_out
upgrade_policy: scheduled_with_customer
egress_ip_preservation: reserved_on_request
blackout_guarantee: monthly_slot
```
```yaml
preset: enterprise
telemetry: off_by_default
upgrade_policy: pinned_or_scheduled
egress_ip_preservation: contract_reserved
blackout_guarantee: contractual
```
Jordan (Sales): Perfect. Can we also show expected availability targets per tier?
Tomas (Infra): Rough guidance: Community 99.5% (best-effort), Managed 99.8% (scheduled maintenance), Enterprise negotiable up to 99.95% depending on SLA and pinned-version tradeoffs.
Priya (Legal): Add a line: 'Pinned versions increase rollback complexity and may extend service restoration time following a failed upgrade.'
Nadia (PM): OK checklist for launch doc: 1) matrix table + single-sentence legal lines 2) presets + sample YAML 3) ops cost footnotes 4) SOW snippet for Enterprise blackout 5) customer onboarding checklist.
setup-bot: Created ticket PRIV-821: "Launch gating matrix + install presets" assigned to Nadia.
Nadia (PM): Action owners: Ravi -> add presets + perf numbers (Tue). Tomas -> infra cost numbers + migration notes (Mon). Priya -> SOW snippet and legal phrasing (Wed). Jordan -> sample quote language and pricing bands (Thu).
Jordan (Sales): I'll run pricing bands by a couple of pilot customers and report back.
Ravi (Eng): One more technical callout: "egress IP hold" requires customers to provide IP allocations and a network contact; otherwise we cannot guarantee preservation.
Priya (Legal): Put that as a prerequisite in SOW: "Customer provides documented IP reservation and network contact."
Nadia (PM): Great. I'll assemble the draft doc and share for review by end of week. Short thread 1/"
